mcp_tool.description:
Remember a durable conclusion as compiled governed knowledge.

    API reference: https://github.com/Artexis10/exomem/blob/main/docs/capabilities.md

For distilled decisions, findings, failures, patterns, experiments and
production logs. Raw material goes to `capture_source`; proof-bearing
artifacts to `preserve_evidence`/`preserve_artifacts`.

sources must resolve to authorized governed Source/Evidence: URLs, remote
IDs and derivative summaries are not originals. Capture first and cite its
path/ref, or use an empty list. UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_CITATION writes nothing.
Details: references/writing.md.

Semantic authoring [exomem.semantic-authoring:v4 sha256:837b03b15c3d83f6c6eeb50771f4eaa04e4beaaae0f7d54be249be40ce7685f7]: Every new, replaced, or activated active compiled note needs at least one valid, non-empty semantic unit. Check new active creates, replacements, and inactive-to-active transitions; inactive drafts may remain unit-free until activation. A post-activation compliant page cannot lose its final valid semantic unit. Under `## Observations`, write `- [category] content #tags (context) ^anchor` with one primary open-vocabulary category; rich form is `## <Governed Kind>` with a substantive body. Choose exactly one primary category: prefer a meaningful epistemic or operational role and put the domain in tags, but if the role would only be a generic fact, finding, or observation and the domain is the durable lens, use a domain category instead. Role example: - [decision] Relocate to a coastal city next spring #life ^relocation `missing_semantic_unit`: Add `## Observations` and `- [operating constraint] Keep retries bounded #reliability`. `empty_rich_unit`: Add substantive body content or remove the empty recognized heading. mcp_tool.description:
Edit an existing memory page with an auditable reason.

    API reference: https://github.com/Artexis10/exomem/blob/main/docs/capabilities.md

Small corrections, sections, strings, opinion rows or frontmatter;
substantial rewrites use replace_memory.

Source edits validate the final sources against authorized Source/Evidence;
unrelated edits leave legacy citations alone.

`RELATION_DISPOSITION_STALE`/`_MISSING`: repeat the identical operation with
`validate_only=true`, then commit unchanged with
`transition_token=<returned transition_token>`,
`relation_disposition="reviewed_none"`,
`relation_review_hash=<returned relation_review_hash>` (not the page
content hash) and a `relation_review_reason`. Or author a relation in the body:
`## Relations` then `- supports [[Knowledge Base/Notes/Research/example-target]]`;
Dataview `supports:: [[...]]` is not supported relation syntax.
See references/writing.md.

mcp_tool.description:
Run a governed, resumable Adoption Studio session over existing material.

    API reference: https://github.com/Artexis10/exomem/blob/main/docs/capabilities.md

Never rewrites, moves or deletes originals. `plan` previews the exact
imports and `apply` commits exactly that plan or refuses. `status` is the
read-only default; `start` is guarded.

start scans; select chooses files; plan previews; apply atomically copies
into Sources; cancel closes pre-apply; finish proves recall. Then work-item
reads context, propose submits proposals, apply-proposal approves one.
Details: references/operations.md.

expected_fingerprint.description: For `apply-proposal`, the reviewed fingerprint; a mismatch refuses.

expected_hash.description: For `apply-proposal`, target page hash for relation and reconciliation-relate approvals.

include.description: For `select`, paths whose eligible files are selected.

initialize_kb.description: For `start`, bootstrap a missing Knowledge Base (otherwise KB_NOT_INITIALIZED).

path.description: For `start`, subtree to scan (default: vault root).

plan_id.description: For `apply`, from `plan`/`status`; a mismatch or changed selection refuses with PLAN_STALE.

response_detail.description: Success detail: compact (default), full, or legacy.

run_id.description: From `start`; required except for `start` and run-listing `status`.

mcp_tool.description:
Maintain vault health; several modes write.

    API reference: https://github.com/Artexis10/exomem/blob/main/docs/capabilities.md

Audit is read-only; fix/backfill-ids default dry-run; reconcile writes.
Remote fix/reconcile/backfill-ids writes return MAINTENANCE_REQUIRES_CLI.
Run those writes with exomem maintain on the host; remote dry_run=true works.

structured-files and tag-variants apply needs the preview's `plan_id` and `why`.
Curation cannot target raw Sources/Evidence, Planning, Records or schema/admin state.
Mode manuals are in references/vault-care.md.

mcp_tool.description:
Manage files through one governed file operation.

    API reference: https://github.com/Artexis10/exomem/blob/main/docs/capabilities.md

For structures typed tools do not fit. Destructive operations need explicit
flags. validate_only/review apply to Markdown create/append.

Semantic authoring [exomem.semantic-authoring:v4 sha256:837b03b15c3d83f6c6eeb50771f4eaa04e4beaaae0f7d54be249be40ce7685f7]: manage_memory_file create, overwrite, and append receive the same semantic precommit contract on the complete resulting compiled Markdown; prefer remember or replace_memory when their typed route fits. Every new, replaced, or activated active compiled note needs at least one valid, non-empty semantic unit. Check new active creates, replacements, and inactive-to-active transitions; inactive drafts may remain unit-free until activation. A post-activation compliant page cannot lose its final valid semantic unit. Under `## Observations`, write `- [category] content #tags (context) ^anchor` with one primary open-vocabulary category; rich form is `## <Governed Kind>` with a substantive body. `missing_semantic_unit`: Add `## Observations` and `- [operating constraint] Keep retries bounded #reliability`. `empty_rich_unit`: Add substantive body content or remove the empty recognized heading. Keys/examples: call bootstrap(profile="full").
